actualCallPath: memoryFixture creates the real Store and ProjectMemory, enabled only through its constructor-local callback and explicit disposable source-thread configuration.
The test creates an exclusive UTF-8 file, captures its canonical path/device/inode, and stores an owning read-only ResourceGrant.
ProjectMemory.captureFile calls actual withResourceGrant and readBoundFile. The Windows branch spawns the fixed system PowerShell and windows-path-guard.ps1.
No file access module, guard, child process, source snapshot or ProjectMemory method is mocked by the test or its fixture; the reviewed Vitest configuration installs no mocking setup file.
positiveAssertions: Exact UTF-8 bytes and SHA-256 revision/digest in a FILE ref; private grant digest retained with the immutable source.
Accepted exact source detail is readable; repeated capture reuses the original ref without Store sequence growth or another source row.
Original file bytes, physical device/inode, size and mtime remain unchanged.
The registered memory.projectV1 and memory.externalRecallExperimentV1 flags are false.
negativeAssertions: Grant removal and an identical-byte physical replacement separately deny sourceAvailable, accepted memory, cached-candidate lexical recall and exact detail.
Recapture rejects MEMORY_SOURCE_DENIED without changing Store sequence or retained sources.
sourceReview.deadlineScope: The current guard file includes the new Hermes-only first-acquire opt-in. This FILE path calls withPathGuard without that option and therefore exercises its ordinary 15-second acquisition bound; it is not proof of the separate cold-Hermes startup allowance.
sourceReview.fixtureCleanup: The fixture closes its Store and removes only its disposable temporary root in afterEach.

inferenceBasis: The actual Windows job is successful, its exact green file summary reports 3 tests with no skipped or failed suffix, and each of the three named cases has a separate green raw line. The shard has other skipped cases; none is assigned to this suite.
